objs.name: document
objs.description: Document managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, versioning, revision, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation and acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version retained and updated through release, revision, validity extension, override and reactivation processes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status maintained for the document and displayed on the web or in reports.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign authorizations for readers via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and the registered author for the workflow.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the workflow.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for the workflow.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the period of extended validity is counted.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From Date and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document and used for templates, abbreviation, extended validity period and archive duration.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Document level used for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation listed for common document types.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period definable for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration definable for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create new documents or to add Additional Info or Attachment to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Participant, reader, author, reviewer, releaser, translator or workflow actor in document management processes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned to documents for authorizations, reader access, distribution, acknowledgement or archiving.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned to authorizations, release process participants or distribution lists.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate released documents that have no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, review, acknowledgement and related processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested for assigned persons or User Groups upon release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language version of released document content.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example that can be linked with documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New document is created in the system by Attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Corresponding document type is selected when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Document template is selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents are uploaded to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents are generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: open_properties_editing
evts.description: Attachment of an object opens the properties editing of the document.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata are maintained automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Document is saved before system-supported conversion.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Current version is displayed as PDF on the web.

evts.name: change_content
evts.description: Subsequent changes are made to released document content.

evts.name: change_property
evts.description: Subsequent changes are made to released document properties.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned in the Control (release) category.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document by Attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is added to a document by Attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is modified and this triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Approval process is initiated after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes the release task positively and the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Rejection during review cancels the workflow for subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Rejection during release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users of status, workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals, validity extension and acknowledgements by e-mail.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Valid and released document is revised, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: New document version is created automatically due to revision or defined triggering changes.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author-rights employee creates a Change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Change proposal is scheduled for implementation and creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, the request is deleted, and the document remains valid in its current version.

evts.name: update_valid_until_date
evts.description: Valid until date is updated by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Release of a new revised version automatically terminates the validity extension process and deletes the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Request for AKS is created for a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Workflow for processing the request for AKS starts automatically after Attachment of the request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Documents and attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All authorizations except archive group rights are revoked at user group and person level.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Request for reactivation is created in the folder provided and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Reactivation workflow starts automatically after request creation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists are maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail notification when a new version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: Author team receives notification as soon as all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: display_dashboard
evts.description: User and role-specific dashboards are filled with information from distribution groups and document lists.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Role-specific evaluation reports and searches evaluate documents or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, clients in which the document is visible or not are specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: New document is created in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Reference to the original document is created for a local document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A template can be selected when creating a new document.
New documents are created by Attachment of a new information object.
External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover.
A document can be supplemented with objects of type Additional Info.
A document can be supplemented with objects of type Attachment.
User Groups are assigned to documents for reader authorizations and distribution.
Persons are assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or distribution recipient.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
The request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Workflow participants complete their tasks.
Workflow tasks are completed with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgements are confirmed for a current document version.
For each document in a multi-client system, clients where it is visible are specified.
Translated and original language versions are associated with a document.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
IT applications are Master data that documents can be linked with.
Documents can be linked with other documents or referenced by a local document.
